jia.name: forest formation
jia.note: Steady action leads to steady progress.  Suggested course of action is passivity.  Keeping the status quo is vital.
jia.desc: One will waddle through various obstacles when he or she is proactive. As such, it is advisable to remain passive. Everything will fare well if you keep calm; what the heart wishes the hands will accomplish

yi.name: green dragon combines spirit
yi.note: Yi Wonder aids the Jia.  Plans will unfold as they should.  (if Door is inauspicious, obstacles may appear)
yi.desc: Auspicious outcome. Denotes positive energy and great strength. However when the Door is inauspicious, the energies would turn inauspicious two folds.

bing.name: green dragon returns
bing.note: Uninterrupted progress on all fronts.  Positive energy unfolds in all spectrums.  (condition: Six Striking Penalty causes negative effects)
bing.desc: Extremely auspicious. Denotes positive outcome in all endeavours. However, when it falls on houses that represent Entering Grave 入 墓 or Striking Punishment, this combination can be extremely undesirable.

ding.name: wood fire brilliance formation
ding.note: Ding Wonder illuminates the way for Jia. Suitable for seeking help, advancing strategy, and finding recognition.  Efforts shall not go to waste.
ding.desc: Good for meeting Noble people and receiving support. Excellent combination for career pursuits and seeking fame. Also good for promotion and getting support from superiors. When it falls on Grave 墓 location, it will be compelled with all previous positive effects nullified.

wu.name: shining green dragon formation
wu.note: Earth and Heaven clash into chaos, depicting neutral outcome and shattered progress.
wu.desc: Heaven counters Earth, pulling in unwanted outcomes. This emulates the effects of Jia-Jia 甲甲combo, which denotes unsuccessful pursuits, lonesome ventures and lack of support.

ji.name: nobleman enters prison
ji.note: Jia is trapped underneath the pressure.  Allies and mentors will cause confusion for strategic action.  Problems may arise in work or personal matters.
ji.desc: Due to lack of support from superiors, this formation is not favorable for either official or personal affairs. Even those who support you will meet with trouble. As such, expect difficulties in whatever you’re embarking on. Misleading instruction and command by others amplify this negative streak.

geng.name: leader flying palace
geng.note: Emotional distress as progress may reverse course.  Competition arises and seek to counter your objectives.
geng.desc: Auspicious matters turning the other way round, and continue to disintegrate. The situation is growing murkier and you are left feeling helpless. You seem to meet with rivals or challengers everywhere, and your feeling of fear and anxiety only attest to this inauspicious stride.

xin.name: green dragon broken feet
xin.note: The great dragon loses its roots.  Generallly inauspicious, but can be nullified with auspicious doors. One should pay attention to the foundation of the matter.
xin.desc: Denotes cutting away your foundation or removing your support. It is only with auspicious Doors you can make plans to escape or avoid a confrontation with your enemies. Meet with negative Doors, however, one may incur major cut-backs and loss of fortune. Also, be aware of injuries relating to your feet.

ren.name: green dragon enters heavenly prison
ren.note: The great dragon is drowned in water. Confusion will arise, followed by mixed transmission of information and communication.  Important details are lost and matters may stagnate.
ren.desc: Not good for romance-related activity. If proceed, you will find that your good intentions being misinterpreted. Nothing in terms of communication and relationship would go well. Obstacles and stagnancy will drag down everything you do.

gui.name: green dragon elegant seal
gui.note: A neutral formation that is dependent on the auspiciousness of the doors.  This formation is related to enemies and rivals.
gui.desc: You can outwit your competitors, and your idea will bear fruitful results. Auspicious Doors in sight, this formation will bring good fortune. Without the presence of inauspicious Doors, however, this formation can cost you unusual setbacks and unpleasant affairs and or stagnant progress.

jia.name: maxes yin supress yang
jia.note: Roots from Heaven meets Tree on Earth. Smooth sailing and steady progress.  Fortified by allies.  Meeting inauspicious Door results in progress blockage.  This formation is related to those around you.
jia.desc: This formation also known as Roots Attacking Jia 藤蘿 擊甲. Everything will be successful and well, adding brilliance to your present splendor. There will be excellent support from friends and related parties. When this formation is compelled by inauspicious Door, it denotes fortune loss and injuries due to problems brought about by people close to you.

yi.name: day noble fu yin
yi.note: As a situation of stagnation, one should not seek advancement or pursue gain.  Risk and volatile decisions should be avoided.
yi.desc: It is not advisable to approach your superior or important contacts for a meeting or discussion. Not advisable also to pursue fame or status or to take risk at this time. Your condition is not changing at a speed that you are comfortable with. Do not take unnecessary risk as you should remain in your sphere of influence.

bing.name: noble crest in position
bing.note: Exciting and uplifting positivity.  Good news shall come.  Auspicious Doors shall result in actualization of desires.  Inauspicious Doors shall result in disconnect or separation.
bing.desc: This combination denotes promotion and celebratory events. At the location of auspicious Stars, you can expect good news in terms of a promotion. Auspiciousness abound if auspicious Door is present, as all your endeavors will go well and the outcome that is desired will be materialized. At inauspicious Door or inauspicious Star, however, one should brace themselves for a separation.

ding.name: noble assisting jade maiden
ding.note: Positive for entering into new relationships and partnerships.  Wonder assists Jade Lady to carry out plans.  Execution in career-related situations shall be effective.
ding.desc: Good for signing contract or deals, Noble Assisting denotes well received ideas and strategy that will be executed effectively and that everything goes well. Very good for carrying out administrative work and examination.

wu.name: noble enters heavenly door
wu.note: Inauspicious for Male. Auspicious for Female. Positive for concealed planning and strategizing.  Working behind the scenes will be enhanced with auspicious Doors.  Inauspicious Doors may result in obstruction, loss, or delay.  Associated with efficient rejuvenation, recovery, and leisure.
wu.desc: Favors female. Male counterpart that opts for this formation should be wary as it is inauspicious for them. Beneficial for scheming and initiating a stealth plan. Whenever auspicious Door is present within this formation, you can execute your plans effectively. With an inauspicious Door, however, brace yourself for wealth loss or bodily harm. This formation is good for meditating, embarking on a leisure travel and getting married.

ji.name: day noble enters mist
ji.note: Wonder walks path and finds cloud. What lies ahead is uncertain and out of sight.  Suggested action is careful progression, stillness, and patience.
ji.desc: This formation denotes uncertainty. The path ahead is unclear or obstructed. Best to conquer the uncertainty by keeping calm and still. Develop inner peace and conquer the unyielding with yielding.

geng.name: day noble punishment
geng.note: Wonder meets enemy Metal.  Strained relationships, attacks on resource, conflicts in progress.
geng.desc: Denotes possible lawsuit and losing of wealth. Relationships become estranged and communications become strained.

xin.name: green dragon escape
xin.note: Yi Wonder (Green Dragon) meets White Tiger (Xin). This formation suggests separation of Yi and Xin.  Wife may leave husband.  Subordinates may leave superiors.  Those under control may detach from existing bonds.
xin.desc: Yi 乙is Green Dragon 青龍 and Xin 辛 is White Tiger 白 虎. Because Yi 乙 Wood can escape when opposed and controlled by Xin 辛 Metal, this formation is thus named Green Dragon Escaping 青 龍逃走. This denotes inauspiciousness, especially in marriage as wife is likely to walk out on the husband. Even in work, subordinates or staff will leave your employment. In the presence of inauspicious doors, this formation may even denote abduction or death of pets from animal abuse.

ren.name: day noble enters earth
ren.note: Revolution is on the horizon.  Conflict between the fresh and the old.  Rebellions between the student and the master.  Advisable to hold situation with steady hands.
ren.desc: Young might rebel against the old, servants turn against their master, and one might be dragged into a messy tangle of lawsuit and constant troubles. Advisable to stick to the tried-and-tested rules as it is not favourable for taking shortcuts or risk. When meet with negative Doors, Stars and Deities, the situation may worsen as life-threatening dangers can be expected.

gui.name: elegant seal meets star
gui.note: Flower meets Mist.  Traditionally regarded as a good formation for rejuvenation, cultivation, recovery, and self improvement.
gui.desc: This formation denotes going into seclusion in favor of self-cultivation or self- reflection. It denotes meditation and spiritual practices.

jia.name: flying bird fall into cave
jia.note: Tree mothers Sun.  In this formation, Sun returns to Mother, indicating natural, uninterrupted progress.  One of the most highly desired formations of the kingdom.
jia.desc: Jia 甲 is the mother (Resource Element) of Bing Fire 丙火. When Bing Fire returns to the mother, it emulates the act of a bird flying back to its cave; hence the name, Flying Bird Fall into Cave 飛鳥跌穴. This denotes that everything falls into place naturally and well; you will succeed without having to stress yourself too much. Everything goes well; you will gain both fame and wealth.

yi.name: bright sun and moon
yi.note: Sun shines on Flower. Wonders gather together to move plans forward.
yi.desc: Both official and personal affairs are well. All you need is better self control. You can execute your plans now.

bing.name: month noble rebelling officer
bing.note: Sun overshines the situation. Possible conflicts and disagreements. Associated with legal, documentation, and administrative problems.
bing.desc: Possible legal issues or lawsuits arising due to contractual problems. Be careful of misplacing important documentation and evidence. In work, be careful of how you handle your important data.

ding.name: month noble red phoenix
ding.note: Sun and Flame guides the way. Associated with meeting noble people, receiving optimistic energy and uplifting support.  Illumination and inspiration surrounds the situation.
ding.desc: Denotes receiving help from a Noble person. This formation also indicates receiving approval or support in writing. Where this formation meets with the Life Door, it forms the Heavenly Dun 天遁 formation. This combination favors self-cultivation and for supporting or inspiring others.

wu.name: flying bird fall into cave
wu.note: Earth reflects Sun, returning to Tree.  Great outlook for success, advancement, and promotion.
wu.desc: Same as Bing 丙 – Jia 甲 combo. Perfect resolution for most matters and you’re likely to achieve both fame and wealth.

ji.name: great rebel enters punishment
ji.note: Sun dries Soil.  A neutral formation suitable for agreements, travel, and ordinary matters. With Auspicious Door comes stability.  With Inauspicious Door comes risk.
ji.desc: It indicates the possibilities of receiving civil support. This combination is auspicious only when meet with Auspicious Doors. It is good for signing contract or pursuing long distance travel. Where it meets with an inauspicious door, this formation will bring about danger and health hazard.

geng.name: shimmering enters great white
geng.note: Sun reveals Iron.  Inauspicious formation indicating stress in relationships related to possessions and ownership.
geng.desc: Highly unfavorable formation. It denotes crumbling family ties or relationships. Loss of belongings or ownership, including possible loss of wealth are imminent.

xin.name: sun moon meeting
xin.note: Sun reveals Gold. Positive formation associated with uninterrupted progress, aid, and allies.
xin.desc: It represents positive outcome stemming from sound strategy. A good medical personnel will appear to cure your illness.

ren.name: fire enters heavenly web
ren.note: Ocean controls the Sun. Supportive of Host.  Not supportive of guest.  Reputation of guest at stake.  Host finds obstacles originally not surfaced.  Stagnation shall result if Inauspicious Door is present.
ren.desc: This formation is more supportive of the Host than of Guest hwo may become the subject of some negative publicity which will impact upon his or her reputation.  Host may also encounter problems, however, if combination meets with inauspicious door resulting in the attitudes of others becoming a stagnant force.  Bing is here opposed and countered by Ren.

gui.name: elegant seal rebelling officer
gui.note: Sun covered by Mist.  Clarity dissipates.  What is to be understood ceases to be comprehended. Words and ideas dissolve into alternate meanings.
gui.desc: This formation suggests an inauspicious outlook.  There could be struggle to be understood, particularly through the written word, and even with the best of intentions one may become the subject of unjust accusations.  Be very wary about the way one puts his or her words across.

jia.name: green dragon salivating the pearl
jia.note: Fire lights the way.  Associated with positive future and hopeful returns.
jia.desc: Denotes a promotion and a bright future ahead. Possible increase in salary and income. A positive formation indicating auspicious outcomes.

yi.name: heavenly flourish formation
yi.note: Fire and Flower helps garden flourish.  Noble people shall appear.  Bliss and happy events come to light.
yi.desc: Indicates the possibilities of receiving help from Noble people, getting a promotion, and a happy marriage. What you sincerely seek, you shall receive.

bing.name: star follows moon turn
bing.note: Fire and Sun dance in harmony. Bliss and happiness shall come, but one shall not take it for granted.  With inauspicious Door, positive situation could soon dissipate.
bing.desc: Indicates possible promotion in career, but you should be mindful that extreme joy might beget sorrow. Everything goes smoothly as you have planned. However if there is a negative door, the positive situation could be short- lived. Where there are negative stars, you must hold back your celebration as your work is not finished. You may experience bigger loss because you cannot endure through minor setbacks.

ding.name: noble enters great yin
ding.note: Two fires come together, wonder grows bright.  Positive situation and natural progress.  Advised to take advantage of the situation before fire burns out.
ding.desc: Although positive matters unfold naturally, you should not take things for granted. Be mindful of your actions. What is good right now, may not last very long.

wu.name: green dragon turn bright
wu.note: Fire and Sun gather on Earth. Allies and mentors shall come to aid. Advised to take advantage of helpful people nearby.
wu.desc: Very auspicious formation. Denotes help from Noble people. Your task or goals will become easier with the help of others.

ji.name: fire enters grappling hook
ji.note: Fire and Ash become one.  Associated with a third party interrupting progress. Advised to be cautious of external influences.
ji.desc: Negative love luck that said to involve a third party in the form of a female. As such, be mindful of treachery and deceit in relationship.

geng.name: hour structure
geng.note: Fire meets Iron, conflict arises.  Blockages and setbacks reveal themselves.  Associated to obstruction in travel, communication, transmission, and plans.
geng.desc: This formation is also known as Jade Maiden Punishment Sha玉女刑殺 Geng 庚 is the Deity of Obstruction, so travelers might not be able to carry on their journey because of blocked communication or obstructed path in travelling. Document and communication are blocked; while events and situations develop inconsistently.

xin.name: red phoenix enters prison
xin.note: Fire captured by Gold. Conflict arises. Loss to both sides. Advised to take defense to prevent any losses.
xin.desc: Nothing goes well. What seems positive now will turn the opposite way later. This combination might cause destruction to both sides.

ren.name: five deities mutual combine
ren.note: Leading Ocean carries Fire.  Noble people shall appear.  Fairness and justice prevails.  At time of need, one finds hope.
ren.desc: Everything goes as you have intended. You will also receive help at the eleventh hour from a Noble person. For your lawsuits, a fair trial is expected.

gui.name: red phoenix diving water
gui.note: Rain puts out Fire.  Plans blocked, ideas miscommunicated.  Intentions misperceived.
gui.desc: Nothing goes well, communication with others might be blocked or be hindered with obstructions. Your good intention is misconstrued and you are misunderstood as well. If there are negative Stars or Door, there’s a possibility of being sued.

jia.name: huge rock crushes wood
jia.note: Mountain falls on Tree. Movement is restricted.  Progress is obstructed.
jia.desc: Everything is obstructed. Think twice if you’re planning any further advancement. It is better to lay low and stay passive.

yi.name: green dragon combines spirit
yi.note: Flower climbs on Mountain. Indication of climbing, steady progress.  Associated with positive returns and profitable endeavors.
yi.desc: A Wu 戊 - Yi 乙 combo. Jia 甲 and Yi 乙 meet at the East, which is the residence of the Green Dragon 青 龍. Hence the term Green Dragon Combines Spirit 青 龍合靈. Highly favorable outcome for making progress and executing plans. It also denotes positive returns on your money. If meet with auspicious Doors, its positive effect would be doubled. But if meet with inauspicious Doors, the positive effects would be nullified.

bing.name: green dragon returns
bing.note: Mountain and Sun protects the Tree. One of the most auspicious formations, this suggests success on all fronts.
bing.desc: This formation is aptly called Green Dragon Protecting Leader 青龍顧首 because Green Dragon 青龍 Jia 甲 Wood produces Bing 丙 Fire, and this combination indicates successful implementation of strategies for success and business. This is an extremely auspicious formation. If this formation Enters Grave 入墓 or is hit with a Striking Punishment 擊刑 formation, the positive event would be revoked in the end.

ding.name: shining green dragon formation
ding.note: Fire shines ahead. Tree produces Fire. Indicates success with surrounding entities, people, relationships, and situations. Indicates proper control of matters in the nearby vicinity. Associated with fame, wealth, and success.
ding.desc: This formation is aptly called Shining Green Dragon Formation 青龍光耀 because Green Dragon 青龍 Jia 甲 Wood produces Ding 丁 Fire, and this combination indicates successful meeting with superiors and establishing important network and relationship with people of stature. It is also highly favorable for garnering fame and material success. Be mindful if it lands in a Graveyard location as it denotes trouble and trauma.

wu.name: fu yin
wu.note: Mountain and Mountain blocks progress. Stagnation dictates current situation. Nothing shall move.
wu.desc: This formation is characterized as a Fu Yin伏 吟structure. It denotes that everything is stagnant and slow at this time. It is better to take time to cultivate the mind and rejuvenate the spirit. It is better to stay on the safe side, remember that passive is better than active at this time.

ji.name: nobleman enters prison
ji.note: Mountain and Soil blocks progress. Associated with allies or helpers obstructed from your sights. Support and assistance shall be withdrawn, and strengt shall decrease.
ji.desc: Ji 己 is derived from the Jia Xu 甲戌 pillar and Xu 戌 is the Grave 墓 for Wu Earth 戊土. This formation can be interpreted as a sign that your Noble person or an individual who is able to help you has been convicted into prison or has been removed. This means you no longer have the backing or support you need. The situation is bad for both official and private affairs.

geng.name: leader flying palace
geng.note: Metal cut down roots. Associated with unexpected disasters, loss of direction, unsteady pace. Associated with worsening profits and health.
geng.desc: As the Lead Star, Jia 甲 is most vulnerable to the clash from Geng 庚 Metal. As such, this formation is named Leader Flying Palace 值符飛宮. It denotes derailing of plans and worsening situations, both due to the unforeseen or uncontrollable circumstances around. If situation were already bad, expect it to get worse. There is unlikely to be any profit from pursuit of business and even for health matters, and this negative streak follows when you’re seeking medication from doctor. This formation also indicates a change of place. Even with auspicious Door, this formation will not turn for good, and things would worsen if it meets with inauspicious Door. All previous efforts will be in vain.

xin.name: green dragon broken feet
xin.note: Gold appears from beneath.  Structures dissolve into chaos, misunderstandings arise to cause confusion and blockage.  Associated with lack of efficiency.  Auspicious Doors shall negate negative consequences.  Inauspicious Doors indicate worsening situations or possible disasters.
xin.desc: As Xin 辛 Metal controls Jia 甲 Wood and Zi 子 clashes with Wu 午, this structure is named Green Dragon Broken Feet 青龍折足. It denotes the breaking down of a structure or system; communication breakdown. Lots of misunderstanding or people unable to carry out their orders effectively or efficiently. If it is found at an auspicious Door the situation can be salvaged despite some setbacks. You may still look out for an opening in the situation. If it is located at an inauspicious Door, it denotes disaster, fortunes loss, or a broken foot or getting hurt.

ren.name: dragon enters prison
ren.note: Ocean water traps Green Dragon Tree.  Indicates the leader pressed against his will, with little options to move. Inability to act results in loss and decay.
ren.desc: As Ren 壬 is the Heavenly Prison 天牢 and Jia 甲 is the Green Dragon 青龍, this formation is named as Dragon Enters Prison 龍入 天牢. This formation denotes struggle and losing faith and hope. Everything is damaged and money is lost.

gui.name: green dragon elegant seal
gui.note: Rainwater falls on Green Dragon Tree. Neutral formation. Meeting Auspicious Door signals joy and satisfaction.  Meeting Inauspicious Door signals disappointment.  Associated with education and academics.
gui.desc: As Jia 甲 is the Green Dragon 青龍 and Gui 癸 is the Heavenly Net or the Elegant Seal 華蓋, this formation is named as Green Dragon Elegant Seal 青龍 華蓋. The formation is neutral unless it is activated by an auspicious Door. It will then denote blessings and happiness. Favorable for scholarly pursuits.

jia.name: dog meets green dragon
jia.note: Soil from above traps Tree. Operational efficiency is reduced.  Speed of progress hindered by obstacles and blockages.
jia.desc: This is an inauspicious formation. Everything is not proceeding smoothly with many obstacles and frustrations. Everything seems to be moving in slow motion and not being productive. If the formation lands on an auspicious Door, plans and strategies will go as you wish. You’re likely to win favor from superiors as well. If it is located on inauspicious Door all efforts will be wasted.

yi.name: hidden grave deity
yi.note: Soil entagle Roots. Indication of cloudy, unclear conditions ahead. Advised tread careful and take appropriate precautions.
yi.desc: As Xu 戌 is the Grave of 乙 Yi Wood, Ji 己 is Earth Gate 地戶. As such, this formation is named as Hidden Grave Deity 墓神不 明. This formation denotes that it is best to keep a low profile and stay away from attention. Everything is murky and unclear. Best to stay secluded or in hiding. Without clarity you cannot act. Hastiness brings disaster.

bing.name: fire rebelling earth door
bing.note: Earth and Fire conflict. Associated with indecency, immorality, and lack of faith. Challenges will be presented.
bing.desc: This formation denotes fighting fire with fire; one needs to make a stand. For women, avoid obscenity and adultery. Nothing goes smoothly without obstacles and struggles. You should know that without struggle, there will be no progress.

ding.name: red phoenix enters grave
ding.note: Fire trapped underneath.  If approach is not careful, indicates volatile changes, unexpected shifts in situation, breakdown of communication, and reckless action.
ding.desc: As Xu 戌 is a Fire Grave, this formation is named as the Red Phoenix Enters Grave 朱雀入墓. It denotes possible lawsuits and complaints. Various twisting of facts and mismanagement of information can be expected as well. Avoid further disasters as a result of speaking without thinking.

wu.name: bright hall receives treasure
wu.note: Support hidden within. Indicates allies and helpers are nearby. Advised to approach for support carefully and at the right moment.
wu.desc: This formation denotes offerings from others and that help is on the way. There will be support but you need to wait for the right time to ask. If it is located at an auspicious Door, everything will proceed well; at an inauspicious Door, however, all efforts are wasted.

ji.name: earth door meets ghost
ji.note: Cemented earth. Stagnation through the situation. Associated with unhappy outcomes, diseases, and decay.
ji.desc: This is a Fu Yin 伏吟 formation. There will be stagnation and obstruction along the way. The outcome will be unfavorable and people battling with sickness might succumb to the disease. This is because Ji 己 is the cemetery.

geng.name: bright hall hidden
geng.note: Iron from below. Brings conflict and disagreements. Resources will be targeted. Reputation will be at stake. Haste is not recommended.
geng.desc: This formation indicates upcoming legal disputes and arguments. Wealth may be lost and your privacy might be intruded. Be careful of being framed. Best to keep a low profile and stay passive. Do not initiate the lawsuit.

xin.name: spirit enters grave
xin.note: Surface does not match that which is below. Appearance seems positive.  Reality is less so.
xin.desc: The formation denotes that things are well on the surface, but going nowhere. It indicates being flashy with no substance. Because of greed, you may lose the big picture.

ren.name: earthly net high stretch
ren.note: Murky waters drown the plans. Associated with alternate motives, dishonesty, and lack of fidelity.
ren.desc: This is an unfavorable formation. It denotes scheming, betrayal, adultery, scandals and treachery.

gui.name: earthly punishment black tortoise
gui.note: Dirty water penalty. Associated with disease, setbacks, and traps.
gui.desc: This is an unfavorable formation. Your plans will not succeed. Possible illness may arise. If meet with inauspicious doors, it denotes health hazard and prison term.

jia.name: great yi hidden palace
jia.note: Iron covers Tree. Indicates darkness arising out of light. A turn from positive to negative. Associated with loss.
jia.desc: This is a highly inauspicious configuration. Denotes a switch from good to bad in a situation, loss of wealth and separation of loved ones.

yi.name: great white meets star
yi.note: Flower and Iron Combine. Neutral formation. Comes with bliss and sadness. Advised to be humble and take a passive stance.
yi.desc: Better to stay passive instead of active. Take note as extreme joy begets sorrow; it is better to conceal your victory to avoid stirring jealousy.

bing.name: great white enters shimmer
bing.note: Metal conflicts fire. Associated with loss, reputation damage, operational obstruction. Emotional distress, anxiety, and uncertainty. Advised to take action rather than stay passive.  This formation favors guest.
bing.desc: Denotes loss of wealth, possibility of being framed or harmed, and orders not carried out efficiently. The situation tortures the mind, body and soul. It favours the guest, not the host. Hence it’s best to be proactive than reactive.

ding.name: white pavilion of deceit
ding.note: Metal covers Wonder. Indicates dramatic shift in situation due to deceit. Associated with loss, damages, and breakup.
ding.desc: There are drastic changes in the circumstances. More will be loss than gained. If there is an auspicious door, there will be a window of opportunity to escape from the problem.

wu.name: sitting palace structure
wu.note: Iron from above stabalizes below. A negative formation indicating initial failure prior to success.
wu.desc: You need to fail before you can succeed. This situation denotes that matters will first need to worsen before you see signs of improvement.

ji.name: punishment structure
ji.note: Associated with disagreements, conflicts, legal problems. Advised to prepare for attacks and instability.
ji.desc: This formation denotes internal arguments, family dispute, debauchery, and lawsuit. Extremely undesirable.

geng.name: great white same palace
geng.note: Clash of Blades. A structure associated with conflict and battle.  Harmony shall disintegrate from within, among peers, allies, mentors, and friends.
geng.desc: Also known as the War Structure. It is one of the more inauspicious formations in Qi Men. Unexpected disaster and misfortune, conflict among siblings, friends, or peers will arise. All matters are not proceeding smoothly and if they are, they will be sabotaged soon.

xin.name: white tiger stem formation
xin.note: Iron and Gold Clash. Associated with problems during travel and journeys.  Related to the opposite gender. Objectives will be pulled apart due to misalignment in goals.
xin.desc: It is inauspicious for traveling afar for work, as traffic accidents or dispute with the opposite sex will plague you. The two Metals denote disputes and battle. There will be struggle and fights. Brace yourself.

ren.name: small structure
ren.note: Leading Ocean meets Iron Structure. A clash of movement and obstruction. Associated with problems during travel, new projects, and fresh endeavors. Advised to stay on path.
ren.desc: Known as the Upper Structure, Ren 壬 Water indicates flowing movement while Geng 庚 is the Deity of Obstruction. It is unfavorable to travel far for business or to accept projects that are away from your core competence. Do not be greedy. You might also feel tied down in the wrong path.

gui.name: big structure
gui.note: Rain meets Iron Structure. Associated with accidents during movement, conflicts and disputes regarding plans and future.  Generally a negative structure for marriages, children, and relationships.
gui.desc: This is known as the Big Structure 大格. As Yin 寅 is in opposition to Shen 申, and Geng 庚 is the path or road, this formation may indicate traffic accidents. It also denotes fights, lawsuits, arguments and disagreements. This is not a good sign, especially when found during childbirth.

jia.name: dragon tiger fight
jia.note: Tiger from above charges down below. Unstable conditions awaiting to worsen. Associated with wasted efforts due to conflicts. Positive outcomes will fail to be recognized.
jia.desc: The situation is unstable. Change is bound to happen for the worst. All efforts are futile as there are disagreements and miscommunications. Talents will remain unrecognized.

yi.name: ferocious white tiger
yi.note: Tiger charges from above to destroy Yi Wonder. Associated with problems during movement and travel. Indicates conflicts, arguments, lack of allegiance, and lack of clarity. Advised to be avoided for relationship matters.
yi.desc: Xin 辛 Metal clashes and counters with Yi 乙 Wood. This formation is named the Ferocious White Tiger 白虎猖狂. Denotes danger during long distance travel, arguments and disputes, loss of faith and courage and uncertainties in the path ahead. Usually not a good formation for marriage.

bing.name: stem combine rebelling officer
bing.note: Bing Wonder arrives to save the day. On appearance, the situation is worsened. In reality, the situation is controlled. Most optimal with Auspicious Door.
bing.desc: The situation may be bad, but it’s under control. Whether its outcome is favorable or not depends on the presence or absence of an Auspicious Door.

ding.name: restricted white tiger
ding.note: Ding Wonder suppresses Xin Metal. A neutral formation. Possible gains if in the presence of an Auspicious Door.
ding.desc: The Ding 丁 Fire controls the Xin 辛 Metal. This denotes a solution to the problem. Doing business will generate considerable profit and even if you are at wrong, you can get absolved from the guilt. With the absense of an auspicious door, everything will start off well but ends badly.

wu.name: trapped dragon receives punishment
wu.note: Mountain traps the Dragon. Indicates rebellion, disloyalty, clash of authority, and betrayal. Emotional distress may arise.
wu.desc: As Xin 辛 Metal counters Jia 甲 Wood, Zi 子 and Wu 午 also silently clash with each other. This formation is named Trapped Dragon Receives Punishment 困龍 受制. It denotes direct changes of authority and disobedience in your colleagues or down line. It also represents financial mismanagement and relational discord. Best to control your emotions and keep yourself level-headed to avoid disaster.

ji.name: enter prison self punishment
ji.note: Xin Metal rebels. Indicates betrayal of apprentice and master. The subordinate goes against the wills of the superior. Righteousness and justice not observed. Advised to be careful with surrounding allies.
ji.desc: As Xin 辛 is the sinner and Xu 戌 is the Grave of Wu Fire this formation is named Enter Prison Self Punishment 入獄自刑. It denotes servant turning against the master, and subordinate challenging the superior. Justice is not served from losing a lawsuit. Take note at work as betrayal, injustice abound.

geng.name: white tiger carrying blade
geng.note: Great Iron carries Sharp Blade. A clash of styles, damages abound. Associated with harm, breakups, separation, and conflicts.
geng.desc: Bodily harm, bloodshed or in some cases, lots of heart breaks. Dispute about everything can occur. An unexpected wound or disease may plague you or the person you love.

xin.name: the grand heavens fu yin
xin.note: Xin Metal Fu Yin. Indicates self-destruction.  Overconfidence leading to failure. Inability to be honest and practical about the situation.
xin.desc: Self sabotaging at work. Be careful of over-committing and under-delivering. Fortunes will be lost and you will have to end up fixing hassles and mess as a result of your inability to control yourself.

ren.name: the grand heavens meet prison
ren.note: Grand ocean suppresses progress. Personal conflicts with others. Obstructions throughout the process.
ren.desc: An unfavorable formation which denotes drawbacks, ill feelings, health hazards and confusion. Too many obstacles plague the way forward. Best to re look your plans.

gui.name: heavenly prison elegant seal
gui.note: Energies of sun and moon stagnate. Progress is bold and optimistic, but reality is setback and slow to improve.
gui.desc: As Xin 辛 is the Heavenly Prison 天牢 and Gui 癸 is the Elegant Seal 華蓋, this formation is named Heavenly Prison Elegant Seal 天牢華蓋. The Sun and Moon grow dim, trapped in the Heavenly Net by mistake. This shows that even though your intentions are pure and your dreams are big, there are forces beyond your control holding you back. Better not be unreasonable at this point. Moving forward is tough and you will be plagued by many obstacles.

jia.name: green dragon enters prison
jia.note: Tree trapped under water. Indicates troubles from inside and outside. Associated with gossip, false truths, lies, and entangelements. Advised to stay out of chaos.
jia.desc: This formation indicates challenges from both domestic and foreign threats. You may be dragged into gossips and be the subject of rumors. Avoid trouble and hassle by staying passive and not getting involved.

yi.name: small snake day noble
yi.note: Ocean water drowns Yi Wonder. Situation worsens with obstacles and flaws. Associated with a pressing force holding down progress, rumors, lies, and loss of faith.
yi.desc: This formation denotes drawbacks and obstructions. Nothing is going on smoothly and plans are flawed. Sometime is tying you down and holding you back. Denotes bickering and betrayal.

bing.name: water snake enters fire
bing.note: Ocean clashes Sun. Associated with conflicts and arguments. Progress will be hindered.
bing.desc: Ren 壬 clashes with Bing 丙. This situation invites lawsuit and disagreements. Since Ren 壬 represents a snake, it represents being trapped or tied down - much like imprisonment. Plans will not succeed as planned and may even turn bad. Opportunities are missed.

ding.name: stem combine snake punishment
ding.note: Flame meets grand Ocean. Neutral formation which indicates a mix of indecision and hesitation. Associated with lack of communication. Favors male.
ding.desc: There are a lot of confusions. Lack of clarity is the cause for the lack of progress in this case. Take time to communicate clearly and clear the air. The situation favors male more than female.

wu.name: small snake dragon force
wu.note: Mountain earth dams water. Associated with positive success, popularity, and fame. Unhindered progress.
wu.desc: The situation favors those who seek fame and reputation. There will be support for your work. Plans will be executed smoothly with little or no hiccup.

ji.name: fierce snake enters prison
ji.note: Ocean snake captured by Earth. Obstruction and blockages in the upcoming path. Goals should be diverted for safety and passivity.
ji.desc: This is a negative formation that implies many obstacles and obstruction ahead. Success is far-fetched. It also represents being framed or put in a situation to solve another person’s problems.

geng.name: great white catch snake
geng.note: White Tiger Geng finds Ocean Snake. Negative formation.
geng.desc: There will be fairness in judgment. As long as you have done no wrong, you need not fear. There is no need to act hastily.

xin.name: flying snake awakens
xin.note: Negative formation associated with lies.  A smokescreen covering the truth.
xin.desc: This structure is named Flying Snake Awakens 螣蛇 相纏 as Xin 辛 Metal enters the Grave at Chen 辰. Snake represents lingering problems and hassle. It implies treachery and deceit. Even at an auspicious House, things are not likely to turn out well. If you are looking out for an opportunity, be mindful as you might be deceived.

ren.name: snake enters earth net
ren.note: Grand ocean floods the scene . Associated with poor luck, unfavorable results. Advised to avoid relationships, marriages, treatments, and new ventures.
ren.desc: Luck is not on your side this time. Your wish will not be granted. Nothing goes well. Be careful of making marriage commitments at this time, delivering a baby or even treating illnesses. The outcome will be unfavorable.

gui.name: young maiden commits adultery
gui.note: Ocean and Mist dims truth. Associated with greed and jealousy.
gui.desc: If it seems too good to be true, it probably is. Greed is the root of the problem. Stop the greed and you can slow down the process of pain.

jia.name: green dragon enters earth
jia.note: Water feeds the Tree. A positive formation where negativity turns into positivity. Associated with receiving help and support from allies and noble people; creativity.
jia.desc: This formation turns bad luck into good. It denotes a positive turnaround and that one will receive help from a Noble person. New ideas will also come freely to you.

yi.name: elegant seal meets star
yi.note: Water feeds Flower. Generally neutral to positive formation with uninterrupted progress. Efficient operations and movement in a desired direction.
yi.desc: Promotion is smooth and the desired outcome can be obtained. The strategy is implemented very effectively.

bing.name: elegant seal rebelling officer
bing.note: Gui Water meets Bing Fire. A neutral formation indicating pleasant progress, although a bit slow. Positive outcomes will flourish, but patience and steadiness is required. Associated with seeking spiritual guidance.
bing.desc: Better stick to the present or tolerate with what you have at hand rather than going beyond the line and pursuing something that is out of your reach. Things will develop slowly and sluggishly. Patience is necessary. Not auspicious either for meeting or asking for favors from another. Except only if you are seeking refuge or wisdom from monk, priest or a spiritual person.

ding.name: demon snake
ding.note: Ding Wonder meets a Snake. Water clashes Fire. Indicates arguments, conflicts, and internal battles. Associated with relationship clashes and possible hazards.
ding.desc: As Gui 癸 Water counters and clashes with Ding 丁 Fire, and Ding Fire burns and boils Gui Water, this formation is named Demon Snake. It denotes being entwined in heated disputes and disagreements. Also denotes health hazards and catastrophies. It spells disasters in partnerships and team work. This is not an auspicious formation.

wu.name: heavenly yi combine
wu.note: Heavenly Mountain marries Rain. Positive formation suitable for marriages, relationships, and meeting others. A sign of harmony and joy.  Associated with noble help, support from allies, and happy gatherings.
wu.desc: Good for wealth and relationship matters. This formation promotes harmony and success. There will also be support from a Noble person. It also denotes good union.

ji.name: elegant seal earth door
ji.note: Murky Waters. Communication flows are disrupted. Inter-personal relationships, marriages, gatherings, and meetings are advised to be pushed back.
ji.desc: Communication is obstructed. Not good for personal relationship matters. Best to be absolutely clear and thorough when giving instructions.

geng.name: great white enters net
geng.note: White Tiger Drained. Rebellious subordinates, allies, and teammembers will disrupt the plan. Associated with ego problems, volatility, chaos, and arguments.
geng.desc: Your strategy is flawed as people’s egos get in the way. Opinionated, unyielding and rebellious. Where this formation lands on an inauspicious Door, one may resort to violent dispute.

xin.name: elegant seal receive grace
xin.note: Negative formation indicating downturn before upside. As situation progresses, matters will turn into positive light. One is advised to be careful with surrounding people, as they could be driven by deviated intentions.
xin.desc: There will be losses before your gain. You could be surrounded by malicious people with ill intent. But the outcome is still favorable as long as you can persevere. This formation is not auspicious for predicting illness.

ren.name: heaven web end prison
ren.note: Water and Water cover the situation. One of the most unfavorable formations. Similar to a Punishment. Associated with trouble and chaos even amidst proper action. Lack of faith, trust, loyalty, and relationship control.
ren.desc: A highly inauspicious formation, where almost nothing is favorable. In fact you may get into trouble just for trying to help others. Marriage may turn sour and relationships become bitter. You may feel stuck as you juggle the lack of trust, commitment and love in your life.

gui.name: heavenly net four spreads
gui.note: Inauspicious formation indicating a downhill spiral. Associated with worsening conditions, complete disharmony in plans, and disintegration of strategy. Advised to delay all important matters until situation has passsed.
gui.desc: This formation is extremely inauspicious. Everything fails on its own. The circumstances are against your wishes. You may lose your way. If you want to predict illness, you’re likely to be greeted with worsening situation. Same goes for relationship, as things will likely to be disintegrated further.

green_dragon_returns.name: green dragon returns
green_dragon_returns.note: One of the three most auspicious structures.  Bing fire comes to aid Jia to burn Geng metal.  Opportunities will rise from the shadows.  Wealth and Career will accelerate to meet your goals.  Positive outcomes in marriages, friendships, and familly all-around.  Audiences will be impressed at one's spectacular display.  Black becomes White; Bad becomes Good.

flying_bird_fall_into_cave.name: flying bird falls into cavern
flying_bird_fall_into_cave.note: One of the three most auspicious formations, this structure depicts a child returning home after a long journey away.  All matters will resolve to a natural balance -- suitable for business negotiations, career advancement, marital affairs, promotions, and studies.  Success will fall on your lap; no need to lift a finger.  Mentors will come to your aid, those around you will be persuaded, and the spirit around you will be lifted.

jade_maiden_watching_the_door.name: jade lady waiting by door
jade_maiden_watching_the_door.note: One of the three most auspicious formations, this formation is suitable for interpersonal relationships, emotional bonds, and establishing rapport.  Positive events with others will unfold and arguments will dissipate.  One will gain the support of seniors and authority in education and career pursuits.

cloud_dun.name: cloud dun
cloud_dun.note: This auspicious formation depicts a boy looking to the sky in wonder, filling his future with hopes and dreams and bringing confidence to his inner self.  This formation suggests that success is on the horizon and will be achieved.

dragon_dun.name: dragon dun
dragon_dun.note: This auspicious formation depicts a dragon gliding through the skies, free to roam the heavens.  This formation is ideal for starting new projects and changes related to home and family.  This formation is associated with water and spiritual enlightenment.  Those who are on a quest to understand themselves will find this formation beneficial.

heavenly_dun.name: heaven dun
heavenly_dun.note: It was once said, "out of the nine, the heaven rises".  There are 9 Auspicious Dun formations, and the Heavenly Den is one of the most auspicious.  This formation depicts an image of a powerful deity reaching down towards man to stabalize his affairs.  The Heaven Dun will bring forth justice and fairness, resulting in forward progress.

earthly_dun.name: earth dun
earthly_dun.note: The Earth Den is an auspicious image of solid, stable things.  Extremely auspicious for maintaining order and keeping the status quo, this formation will give energy to those who are on a step-by-step climb to reach their goals.  This formation supports internal growth in a manner that is predictable and welcomed.

man_dun.name: man dun
man_dun.note: This auspicious formation paints a picture of a visionary giving orders in the center of the stage.  Extremely beneficial for those who need to rally support, raise morale, and recruit newcomers to the team.

wind_dun.name: wind dun
wind_dun.note: The wind carries all things, as it was said.  This auspicious formation depicts information and memes flowing through society at quick speed.  Marketing endeavors will likely succeed, and word of mouth will grow to support the idea.

tiger_dun.name: tiger dun
tiger_dun.note: The tiger is one who attacks without hesitation.  This auspicious formation paints a picture of a courageous leader attempting any and all strategies to achieve his goal, eventually arriving at success.  This formation will bring one persistence and determination to aggressively remove any obstacle standing in the way.

deity_dun.name: spirit dun
deity_dun.note: The Spirit Den is arguably the most powerful of the Dens, as it is able to connect the individual to the fifth level of the heavenly sphere.  In Qi Men Dun Jia, the spirit dimension is responsible for the highest uncontrollable forces, and this formation allows one to form a direct connection to this level.

ghost_dun.name: ghost dun
ghost_dun.note: The Ghost Den is an auspicious formation that gives he who wields it the power of the shadows.  One will achieve the mission while hiding in plain sight.  Enemies will cease to notice; eyes will wander away.  Beneficial for those who wish to surprise the enemy.

yi_noble_receives_envoy.name: yi wonder meets envoy
yi_noble_receives_envoy.note: In this formation, the pieces of the game are in the right position.  Team members are focused on their duties, goals are aligned, and motivation is present in all persons.  This is a positive indicator for all wealth, health, and relationship matters.

bing_noble_receives_envoy.name: bing wonder meets envoy
bing_noble_receives_envoy.note: As one of the Three Wonders, Bing lights the way for Jia's path.  This formation depicts the noble receiving new opportunities for growth.  Plans will fork into rivers and streams as information will come to the noble at the right moment in time.  Actions taken will seem to fall in place, and decisions will seem solidified.  Suitable for all matters -- including relationships, careers, and business.

ding_noble_receives_envoy.name: ding wonder meets envoy
ding_noble_receives_envoy.note: Ding enters the palace of Xun or Geng, receiving the necessary support for Jia.  This auspicious formation suggests positive development at every step.  As long as one is grounded and careful, education, career, and marital pursuits should be well secured.  This is an execellent formation for developing a skill or talent.

yi_noble_rising_palace.name: yi wonder rises palace
yi_noble_rising_palace.note: This auspicious formation is suitable for obtaining information.  Particularly well-suited for negotiation and research matters where specialized knowledge is hard to gain.  The Yi Wonder will assist in revealing such information to the surface.

bing_noble_rising_palace.name: bing wonder rises palace
bing_noble_rising_palace.note: This positive formation depicts a sun shining into darkness, destroying evils and revealing virtue.  Traditionally used by law enforcement to fight crime, this formation is helpful when one's intention can be seen in the light, in which case, progress will likely ascend without hindrance.

ding_noble_rising_palace.name: ding wonder rises palace
ding_noble_rising_palace.note: This auspicious formation brings justice to the forefront of the situation.  No conspiracies or hidden agendas can escape the flame of Ding.  Relationships, battles, and business are all favored when Ding reaches the West, as this is the case.

real_deception.name: real deceit
real_deception.note: Suitable for meditation, praying, healing, and growth.  The Great Moon is the spirit of the night and guards over the Yin nature of rejuvenation, consciousness, and awareness.

double_deception.name: double deceit
double_deception.note: Double Deceit is an extremely advantageous formation to enhance the capable appearance of the individual.  Competitors and enemies will find it difficult to gauge your status, and you will appear with much more potential than reality holds.  This formation is also suitable for families, relationships, self improvement, and defense.

nobility_deception.name: noble deceit
nobility_deception.note: This structure is formed when Harmony meets a Three Wonder at an auspicious Door.  The deity of Harmony governs personal affairs and relationships.  This formation will enhance the signal of trust, surrounding one with an aura of influence and fame.  Enemies may mistaken you as one who is not a threat, perhaps leading them to a hasty, wrong action.  This formation is suitable for those seeking help, rejuvenation, or enlightenment.

heavenly_fake.name: heaven conceal
heavenly_fake.note: The Heaven Spirit is responsible for vision, intuition, and the future.  The heaven conceal formation brings the element of bad luck to within one's control.  This formation is most useful for gaining alliances, influencing those in power, and making plans to progress in academics or career.  Gaining traction in numbers is the focus of the structure.

earthly_fake.name: earth conceal
earthly_fake.note: Man hides in Mountain in this auspicious formation of camouflage.  This cloak will make investigation and exploration positive.  One may be able to slip by obstacles at ease.  This formation is suitable for remaining undetected.

man_fake.name: man fake
man_fake.note: Originally used for arresting criminals and finding missing people, this formation brings justice to the forefront.  Travelling is well supported, as the heaven spirit will guide those who wish to avoid tragedies.

deity_fake.name: deity fake
deity_fake.note: The deity concel formation is suitable for meditation, traversing the inner consciousness, and finding oneself on the right path.  The divine will bring forth energy to those who are concentrated on self improvement.

ghost_fake.name: ghost fake
ghost_fake.note: The Ghost Fake formation depicts stillness within darkness.  Those who activate this formation will discover a journey towards the inner mandala, recognizing the elements that defines the Self.  This auspicious formation is suitable for planning and staging before a grand attack.

sun_prosperity.name: Sun Prospers
sun_prosperity.note: The Yi Wonder glows in the palaces of Xun and Kan, suggesting fame and recognition.  Those who wish to expand their business will find that resources and alliance support will come to aid.  This formation indicates an opportunity to show their talents -- if one choose to take it.  Finance, investments, and trade are benefited, and fortune may come.

moon_prosperity.name: Moon Prospers
moon_prosperity.note: Bing fire is the right hand of Jia.  When in the right palace (Xun or Zhen), this auspicious formation suggests a sudden turn of luck as a helpful ally will appear to offer encouragement or a sudden windfall will lift one out of troubles.  One will then find the motivation necessary to climb upwards.

star_prosperity.name: Star Prospers
star_prosperity.note: This auspicoius formation depicts the Ding noble wandering into a garden of dreams.  One may find that their goals will come closer to achievement.  Insights will spring into the mind, allowing one to utilize streams of creativity to further advance.  The horizon of aspirations stretches far and wide.

super_assisting_structure.name: super assisting
super_assisting_structure.note: This formation is suitable for forming relationships with others -- gaining new allies and friends, seeking knowledge from mentors, and reestablshing old ties.  One must be careful to stay focused on the subject at hand and not stray from the goal.  Mentors and helpers may give positive energy to support your endeavors.

quan_yi.name: Huan Yi / Quan Yi
quan_yi.note: This auspicious fomation depicts a legendary warrior training at dawn.  Suitable for matters that require intense effort to succeed, this formation is supreme in that a Three Wonder from the heavens meet with the Jia on Earth.  With persistence, success will not be unattainable.

three_noble_spirit.name: three wonder spirit
three_noble_spirit.note: This auspicious formation will help one develop a clear path as one strives forward.  Strengths and weaknesses will be revealed.  This formation does not automatically guarantee success, but will come to great aid if preparation and planning is in order.

ferocious_white_tiger.name: vicious white tiger
ferocious_white_tiger.note: Xin is the knife that cuts Yi Wood.  The vicious white tiger indicates that a storm is ahead.  One should be careful with every step and avoid drastic decisions.  If one is uncertain, calm meditative practices may be wise to secure a decision.  Relationships, marriages, new constructions, and new business plans should be carefully considered.

tangling_snake.name: entangled snake
tangling_snake.note: Gui water rains on flame.  An entangled snake is one which cannot smoothly proceed without conflict.  One will find that in order to reach a conclusion, small and minor issues must be resolved before giant steps can be taken.

green_dragon_escape.name: green dragon runs away
green_dragon_escape.note: The Green Dragon indicates prosperity and fortune, but this formation indicates that the confident energy is absent.  One should think twice before making dramatic changes.  It is advised to take the calm road at this moment.

red_phoenix_diving_water.name: sparrow dives into river
red_phoenix_diving_water.note: Arguments and conflicts may escalate into serious battles.  When the Ding wonder enters water, the flame is lost.

shimmering_enters_white.name: shimmering white
shimmering_enters_white.note: Also known as Mars Enters Venus.  Time will be the most valuable asset, as this structure suggests danger lurking ahead.  One should look for obstacles and traps before pushing forward into battle.  Wisdom suggests reconsidering one's options -- perhaps finding an alternate route to the destination.

great_white_enters_darkness.name: white enters dark
great_white_enters_darkness.note: Also known as Venus Enters Mars, this formation favors the guest and suppresses the host.  Geng metal is the enemy of Jia, and this special formation depicts a rising inauspicious light.  One should approach the matter proactively (as the guest) in order to secure the victory.

punishment_structure.name: punishment
punishment_structure.note: This inauspicious formation depicts a pattern of chaos spiralling out of control.  Geng meets with Ji to trap the Jia.  Not suitable for financial decisions, legal entanglements, negotiations, or disputes

war_structure.name: war configuration
war_structure.note: This inauspicious formation suggests tragic loss and disaster.  With both Geng metals as the stems, danger could lie ahead if one is not careful.

noble_structure.name: three wonders setting
noble_structure.note: Geng is the mortal enemy of Jia.  In this inauspicious combination, Geng metal combines with one of the Three Wonders -- Yi, Bing, and Ding.  This formation is not suitable for matters related to conflict or competition.  One must be careful when dealing with money matters.  If Yi is combined, Guest is favored.  If Bing or Ding is combined, Host is favored.

flying_stem_structure.name: flying stem
flying_stem_structure.note: Obstacles reveal themselves every day, but this one will affect one's relationship in the professional world.  This inauspicious formation creates problems for the individual.

big_structure.name: big configuration
big_structure.note: This inauspicious formation illustrates that an important element of the solution is missing.  One cannot proceed without having a complete set of tools and support for the situation.

small_structure.name: small configuration
small_structure.note: This inauspicious structure depicts a military strategist trapped in a continuous mental cycle with no new ideas to proceed.  This structure directly affects the ego and self esteem of an individual, limiting his ability to formulate.

flying_palace_structure.name: flying palace
flying_palace_structure.note: This inauspicious formation harms both host and guest.  It depicts that although a general can control his troops, he cannot control the weather.  Forces outside of the general's control will throw curve his plans, which may need to be adapted to the new environment.

sitting_palace_structure.name: sitting palace
sitting_palace_structure.note: This formation indicates a loss of leadership vission.  Subordinates may lose faith; co-workers may distrust.  The mission will stagnate as obstacles will emerge to hinder progress.  The future is blurry, and one should tread carefully when making decisions.

three_noble_enters_graves.name: three wonders in tomb
three_noble_enters_graves.note: The Three Wonders (Yi, Bing, Ding) is the cornerstone of Qi Men Dun Jia.  In this formation, a Wonder is in tomb (palace).  Efforts will slowly progress.  Positive matters will turn negative.  Support will dwindle and relationships may be impacted.  Critical decisions are better off delayed as the storm passes.  At this point, hesitation may be a wise choice.

three_noble_restricting_or_controlling.name: three wonders suppressed
three_noble_restricting_or_controlling.note: This neutral formation indicates one of the Three Wonders landing in a palace that supresses its strength.  As the job of a Wonder is to protect the Jia, this formation suggests that the Wonder is unable to perform its duty to the fullest extent.  However, hope is not lost.

six_crest_striking_punishment.name: six crest strike penalty
six_crest_striking_punishment.note: The Six Crest Penalty is an inauspicious formation that denotes an individual being pressed against a wall from all sides, leaving no room for escape.  This causes an emotional disaster, as the individual is forced to make a choice with no positive outcome.

childbirth: Baby (male if Yang Door, female if Yin Door)
Baby (male if Yang Stem, female if Yin Stem)
health: Time of critical stage of illness / category of illness
Reproductive system / kidney / bladder / urinary tract / lower abdomen
Stomach / spleen / intestines / right upper limb
Head / large intestine / back / joints / right leg
Lung / right abdomen / throat / esophagus / mouth / skin
